one_line: One hand flipping a real book near a window for 13 s: a cheap, clear product shot.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a hand holds a paperback tilted before white blinds; the cover shows a cartoon toddler in a straw hat with farm animals. Text near the top, "הגרלה הגרלה הגרלה !!!". No speech. The book opens at 0:02.
q1_hook.why: A free prize is the first word, and the book is handled at once (H1, T3, S1). But there is no voice, and the text is gone by 2.4 s, so the viewer learns neither what is won nor how (H4, H2).

beats.what: A hand holds the tilted paperback before white blinds; "הגרלה הגרלה הגרלה !!!"
beats.why: Offer and product in the first frame

beats.what: Page flips: full-page farm pictures of the same child with a sheep, pig and hen; no text
beats.why: A new picture every 1 to 2 s

beats.what: More flips: the child with a sheep and chick, a horse by a barn, an arch view
beats.why: Shows print quality, but adds no new idea

beats.what: The cover again, closer, with its printed title
beats.why: Returns to the frame the Reel opened on

beats.what: Cover with "בהצלחה" and a crossed-fingers emoji

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None in the video. The caption lists six entry steps: follow two accounts, like, tag a friend, comment the child's name, share to a story and tag.
q2_flow.why: A new picture every 1 to 2 s for 13 s, all of the same book, with no word on screen after 2.4 s (R3, F8). It ends on the cover it opened on, a loose loop (R4). A prize with no rule shown is a thin reason to keep watching (H2).

q3_cta.what: The video has only "הגרלה" (0:00) and "בהצלחה" (0:17), no steps. Caption: six entry steps (follow @alma_hadad_ and @mebook.ai, like, tag a friend, comment the child's name, share to a story and tag), draw on 13.3.
q3_cta.why: Six asks, most for the count: like, tag, share, follow twice (C1, C2, R6). All of them sit in the caption; the video never says or shows one (C6). Asking the child's name is specific, but it is an entry rule, not a question that earns a real answer (C5).

q4_shown.what: A hand holds a paperback with a toddler in a straw hat on the cover (0:00-0:02); page flips through full-page farm pictures of the same child, text pages opposite (0:02-0:15); the cover again. No person, price, photo or screen recording.
q4_shown.why: A real printed book flipped in the hand shows print quality, and the title carries a child's name (S1, S2), but no real photo sits beside the pictures (S2). How the book is made is never shown (S8), and no customer voice vouches (S6).

q5_edit.what: 4 or 5 shots in 18.1 s: one continuous handheld take from 2.4 to 15.4 s, then two short cover shots. Pictures change about every 1.3 s inside the take. No speed changes seen. Text only at 0:00-0:02 and 0:17. Ends on the cover.
q5_edit.why: A change every second inside one take keeps the eye busy without cuts (E2), but 13 s of the same book is a long hold with little new information (R1). The message sits in two text cards, and sound is unknown (E4). It ends on a sign-off, no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A giveaway: two winners get a free personalised children's book; the caption ties it to keeping small children busy in the shelter during alarms.
q6_topic.why: A free prize explains most of the interest, and the list has no principle for giveaways. The caption speaks to a real parent need (K6), but the video itself carries no story or feeling (K1).

q7_filmed.what: A handheld one-hand hold of the book before white vertical blinds, in daylight; medium framing, tilted; a ringed hand flips the pages. No face, no child. The book fills about half the frame, backlit.
q7_filmed.why: A hand and the book on a home window are a cheap, native shot (S4, H8, F7). The illustrations are readable, but the story text is too small (F4). Full-screen vertical, no borders (F1).

q8_text.on_screen: White text with a dark outline, two lines, about 20 to 30% down, only until about 0:02: "הגרלה הגרלה הגרלה !!!". At 0:17: "בהצלחה" with a crossed-fingers emoji, on the cover. No subtitles or labels between. The cover title is printed on the book.
q8_text.caption: "הגרלה הגרלה הגרלה !". About 110 words: a shelter story, the prize, six steps with sparkle bullets, the draw date, a closing wish. No hashtags; the brand tag sits inside a step; no disclosure word.
q8_text.why: A one-idea headline in the first second, clear of the top 14% (T3, T4). The caption's first line repeats the hook (T7), but it has no product or occasion words beyond the prize and no hashtags (T7). The partnership is never stated (T8).

weak_points: Six entry steps built on likes, tags and shares; none of the steps in the video; the prize text gone after 2.4 s; no disclosure word; "AI" in the caption; story text unreadable.
lumebook_takeaway: Hold the real book against a window and flip pages for 10 s, with one big word in the first 2 s and one pointer written at the end.
not_verified: Audio: the transcript is only "תודה רבה", so speech is absent; music is unknown. Entrants and winners; whether the book is a sample. The 398 public comments (15 Oct) are the entry mechanic, not a measure of the video. Correction to coded file: the headline is on screen only 0:00 to about 2.4 s, not the first 3 s. The cover title carries a child's name, not quoted.
